params.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1, a packshot of a red pave heart pendant on a cream plaster cube. Its construction stays exactly as in IMAGE 1: ONE puffed heart covered all over in tiny red pave stones deepening from bright red to dark red at its edges, ONE round clear stone in a polished rose-gold collar at its centre. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
